questions.q: Could you give me some ______ on my presentation slides?
questions.exp: feedback 不可數：不加 -s、不加 a，也不能搭只接複數的 many。some 可以接不可數名詞。

questions.q: The new ______ arrived this morning and will be installed tomorrow.
questions.exp: equipment 不可數，不加 -s、不加 an；要數得說 pieces of equipment，不能省掉 of。

questions.q: It took us almost ______ hour to find the conference venue.
questions.exp: hour 的 h 不發音，開頭是母音的音，用 an。a 還是 an 看發音，不看字母。

questions.q: Ms. Kim works at our Seoul branch. She is ______ engineer.
questions.exp: 說一個人的職業用 a／an；engineer 開頭是母音的音，用 an。some、much 不接單數可數名詞。

questions.q: We received ______ applications than we expected, so we extended the deadline.
questions.exp: 後面有 than 要比較級，applications 是複數可數名詞，用 fewer。little、much、a little 都接不可數名詞。

questions.q: The ______ of time we spend in meetings has increased this year.
questions.exp: time 在這裡是不可數名詞（時間），說「量」用 amount of；number of 後面要接複數可數名詞。

questions.q: ______ visitor must sign in at the front desk.
questions.exp: visitor 是單數名詞，只有 every 接單數；all、both、many 後面要接複數名詞。

questions.q: We have two printers. One is working, but ______ is broken.
questions.exp: 一共兩台，一台說過了，剩下那一台是 the other。another 是「再一台」，不是「剩下那台」；others 是複數，配不上 is；other 單獨當主詞時前面要有 the 這類字。
staff 指一群員工，沒有加 s 的複數：500 staff。staff's 是所有格，後面還要接名詞。

questions.q: The three sales managers share one office. Please leave the documents in the ______ office.
questions.exp: 三位經理共用的辦公室，-s 結尾的複數 managers 的所有格只加撇號：managers'。managers's 寫法錯誤；manager、managers 少了所有格符號。
